extraction.title: Delayed Completion of Projects and Idle Projects
extraction.heading: Basis for Conclusion
extraction.subreport: REPORT ON LAWFULNESS AND EFFECTIVENESS IN THE USE OF PUBLIC
extraction.finding_text: Delayed Completion of Projects and Idle Projects The County Executive had incurred an expenditure of Kshs.1,760,546,341 on seven (7) projects. However, one (1) project was completed but not in use, one (1) had stalled one (1) was in complete while four (4) projects status and their details were not provided to enable physical inspection. In the circumstances, value for money for the amount on the projects totalling Kshs.1,760,546,341 could not be confirmed.

extraction.title: Incomplete and Stalled Projects
extraction.heading: Basis for Conclusion
extraction.subreport: REPORT ON LAWFULNESS AND EFFECTIVENESS IN THE USE OF PUBLIC
extraction.finding_text: Incomplete and Stalled Projects Physical inspection conducted in July, 2025 of twelve (12) sampled projects in the County amounting to Kshs.219,207,350 revealed that nine (9) projects were incomplete, while three (3) had stalled. In the circumstances, value for money on the procurement of projects could not be confirmed.

extraction.title: Stalled and Unutilized Projects
extraction.heading: Basis for Conclusion
extraction.subreport: REPORT ON LAWFULNESS AND EFFECTIVENESS IN THE USE OF PUBLIC
extraction.sub_section: REPORT ON THE FINA NCIAL STATEMENTS
extraction.finding_text: Stalled and Unutilized Projects Review of the Project Progress Report and physical verification carried out in the month of October, 2025 revealed that seventeen (17) projects with a total contract sum of Kshs.509,485,588 stalled at various stages of implementation. However, no satisfactory explanation was provided for the delay in completion and updated project status reports were not provided to confirm the current status of the projects. Further, physical inspection conducted in May, 2025 revealed that five (5) projects, with a total value of Kshs.186,327,912 had been completed but had not been put into use. No justified explanation was provided for the failure to utilize the projects to serve the public. In the circumstances, the value for money of the expenditure on stalled and unutilized projects could not be confirmed.
